svg.title: Either way of signing in ends at the same dashboard
svg.desc: Activity diagram. Start. Open sign-in page. Has a password? [yes]: enter password (step 4). [no]: enter one-time code (step 5). Enter password. Enter one-time code. Show dashboard. End.
